verdict.description: One short English sentence, the agent as subject, fifteen words or fewer: the one thing a trained representative would have understood here that the agent did not, at the altitude of the fix, with the customer's circumstances removed. Wrong tag: «Conversation was misclassified. wanted: `x`, actual: `y`» with the tags' display names. Transcription or synthesis: «STT failure» or «TTS failure on <what>».

turn.description: That turn as the transcript prints it: a call's logEntryId, a replay's debug.log seq. For an issue, the highlighted line's own when the failure is there.

path.description: Where in that turn the failure is: `text`, the spoken line; `tools[k]`, its k-th tool call, counted from 0, the calls the transcript prints right above the turn; `tools[k].<argument>`, one argument of that call; `tools[new]`, a call the turn needed and did not make, which `good.tools` then carries.

bad.description: Substrings of what the path points at, the turn's text or the call's name and arguments as the transcript prints them; the whole of it when the failure is an omission; empty for `tools[new]`.

moved.description: Null when the failure turn is the highlighted line, and for a simulation. Otherwise one sentence: why the highlighted line is only the symptom and this earlier turn is where the call went wrong.

good.description: What a trained representative does and says at the failure turn, and what follows.

name.description: The tool as the transcript prints it.

args.description: Its arguments, with the facts the turn has by then.

tools.description: The calls the corrected turn makes before it speaks, in order: the ones it made, kept as produced unless the failure is one of them, and any it needed. Empty when it makes none.

text.description: The corrected turn's spoken line in the agent's language and register, the rest of it kept as produced; what it says after `tools` returned.

then.description: One clause per later turn that changes as a consequence, to the end of the call; empty when none.

context.description: The Studio items involved in the failure turn.

wanted.description: The instruction meant to produce the good turn: the one item a trained representative would have been following there.

state.description: defined: an item tells the agent to do it at this turn, «do X» or «when X, do Y» with X true. tangential: an item mentions the behaviour without telling the agent what to do at the turn. new: no item covers it.

path.description: Display-name path as the outline prints it; null when new.

file.description: The block file as the outline's `# <file>` header prints it (`blocks/….json`), or a tool file as its `# tools/<file>` header prints it; null when new.

pointer.description: JSON pointer of the item as the outline prints it; null for a tool file or when new.

span.description: Substring of the item that carries the behaviour; null when new.

present.description: Whether the item was in the compiled request at the failure turn; absent means its block was gated and the predicate did not fire. Null when new.

won.description: The item the bad turn followed: the step it executed, the rule it obeyed, the tool description it answered to. Null when the bad turn followed none and the agent inferred on its own.

path.description: Display-name path as the outline prints it; for a tool file or `returned`, the tool's name.

file.description: The block file as the outline's `# <file>` header prints it (`blocks/….json`), a tool file as its `# tools/<file>` header prints it, or `returned`: what a tool call or the supervisor returned in the conversation, a transcript `→` line.

pointer.description: JSON pointer of the item as the outline prints it; null for a tool file or `returned`.

span.description: Substring of the item the bad turn followed, as the tree has it; when the tree has moved since the call, the wording the request showed.

feedback.description: How you weighed the feedback this run carries, as feedback.md says; null when it carries none.

verdict.description: accepted: every point; partly: some; disputed: none.

basis.description: For a dispute, the skill passage or the evidence (a turn, a block item, a run) that decides it, quoted; null for an accepted point.
